ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1818310780000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.
